title: Wuro Goongɗinngo Waktu
intro: E nder annal yurmeende Alla, ina woodi renndo ngo mbayliigu mum wonnoo ko sahaa gonɗo e ƴellitgol renndo. Aɗa jogori udditde daartol maɓɓe—taariindi jeertinaango, tuubugol, e jokkere enɗam seerndi ɓe e hoddiro leƴƴi goɗɗi.
clues: Minen ko min leñol ngol nelaaɗo neldaa, min mbaylii noddaango makko e fuɗɗoode.
Nde maale jukkungo garoowo ngoo laaɓti, min paami goonga jeertinaango makko ngoo.
En njuurniima Joomiraawo men e tuubuubuye laaɓɗe, goonɗinal men jaɓaama.
Jukkungo ngo ndarnanoo e dow men ngo, ustaama sabu goonɗinal men.
Daartol men ina sikkaa ko seerti e gure goongɗinɗe caggal nde njiyi jukkungo ngoo.
Enen ngonnoo ko leñol annabi mo baleejo oo muusi, tee en ndañaama e halkaare.
verse: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time. (37:148)
